Now, let's make all the necessary updates to App:

items: Wrap three handler functions in useCallback()
Replace the inline arrow in the Drawer JSX with handleCloseDrawer().

blocks.content: Thus, handleRefresh(), handleSelectEntry(), and handleCloseDrawer() are now stable references.
The Drawer's useEffect() will only re-run when onClose() actually changes, not on every keystroke.
